cases.title: Statement export
cases.text:
# Statement export

## Rules
- For a completed month, only the account owner can download a CSV statement for that account.
- The CSV includes the transaction ID, booking date, ISO currency code, and amount in minor units.
reference_requirements: For a completed month, only the account owner can download a CSV statement for that account.
The CSV includes the transaction ID, booking date, ISO currency code, and amount in minor units.

cases.title: Ledger retries
cases.text:
# Ledger retries

## Rules
- A retry of a settled transfer must append another debit for the same operation ID.
- Each operation ID may produce at most one debit entry.

anchors: A retry of a settled transfer must append another debit for the same operation ID.
Each operation ID may produce at most one debit entry.

reference_requirements: A retry of a settled transfer must append another debit for the same operation ID.
Each operation ID may produce at most one debit entry.

cases.title: Settlement cutoff
cases.text:
# Settlement cutoff

## Rules
- A same-day transfer submitted before 16:00 UTC is included in today's settlement batch.

anchors: A same-day transfer submitted before 16:00 UTC is included in today's settlement batch.
A same-day transfer submitted at 15:30 UTC is excluded from today's settlement batch.

reference_requirements: A same-day transfer submitted before 16:00 UTC is included in today's settlement batch.
A same-day transfer submitted at 15:30 UTC is excluded from today's settlement batch.
cases.companion:
# Companion policy

- A same-day transfer submitted at 15:30 UTC is excluded from today's settlement batch.
